summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for new 8004scan BSC Mainnet integration on public URL. All backend regressions and new onchain tests passed; frontend /onchain and navigation work, with non-blocking but visible external image/mixed-content console issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Several agent images fail to load due mixed-content/CORS/blocking from external image URLs (including localhost links) causing broken visuals.

integration_issues.issue: Source-provided image URLs include insecure or blocked origins (e.g., localhost/http, blocked cross-origin hosts), producing browser console errors and missing thumbnails.

action_items: Add URL sanitization/fallback for onchain image_url (reject localhost/insecure http origins on HTTPS frontend).
Optionally proxy or normalize third-party image assets to reduce CORS/ORB failures and improve onchain card stability.
Keep startup status polling in frontend robust for transient 'running/loading' sync states after deploy/reload.
critical_code_review_comments: sync status endpoint is eventually consistent during startup; clients can temporarily see running/loading with 0 sampled and should handle this state explicitly (already partially done on UI).
Onchain image rendering currently trusts source URLs directly; this leaks mixed-content/cross-origin noise to users and should be guarded by allowlist/proxy/fallback strategy.
Backend projection/privacy controls are correctly excluding raw_8004scan and key fields from public API responses.
test_credentials: Checked /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth testing; file exists but contains no credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://agent-marketplace-131.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest result: 25 passed (13 regression + 12 onchain/security/persistence checks). Verified: /api/integrations/8004scan/status success fields, /api/onchain/agents projection and filters, /api/onchain/agents/{token_id} valid+404, Mongo uniqueness (chain_id+token_id), frontend navigation Marketplace/Onchain/Compare, no horizontal overflow desktop, and no API key/header leak in response/body/bundle/console logs.
rca of the issue: RCA for visible frontend issue: raw source catalog includes image_url entries pointing to localhost/http and blocked external origins. Browser enforces HTTPS mixed-content + loopback/CORS rules, so thumbnails fail despite core data load succeeding. Mitigation: validate image URLs server-side in projection, strip/replace unsafe hosts, and provide deterministic fallback image for invalid URLs.
